items.title: 68154_Gus Johnson oral history interview
items.q: Cliff Leeman, he's been kind of sick. And maybe something might happen to get you out there.

ctx.x: And he said, 'Well, I will. Cliff Leeman, he's been kind of sick. And maybe something might happen to get you out there.' So I said, 'Well, that's great.'
And then, first one thing and then the other, and I didn't see him anymore after that.
